scope: Core/ACP/supporting packages; optional native subagent registry provenance is additionally tracked by SUBAGENTS_SOURCE.json.
changes: Root Boot omits product/workflow/job/subagent/schedule/skills/file-observation/user-question services.
Agent manager/loop remove ProjectBinding, prepared project publication and persisted project-input receipt; retain actual execution algorithm.
Agent disposal removes job/subagent coordinator callbacks; generic callback self-wait gate extracted from subagents_lifecycle.go.
Nested tool lineage context extracted from jobs.go without job execution; agent activation reservations extracted from agent_reopen.go without child reopening.
ACP omits schedule host and workspace registry; retains protocol/lifecycle and per-session MCP.
Harness RetryExecutionPolicy key is local composition rather than dependency on llm/runtime.
harness_test.go omits duplicate assertion against whole-product contract fixture; explicit identical event order assertion remains.
New executable composes explicit static provider, JSONL persistence and ACP without product defaults.
Approval.Decide removes Host browser_start/full-access bypass: never always rejects; regression updated.
MCP HTTP refuses redirects to avoid reapplying explicit credentials to another destination; regression added.
CLI removes the actual credential variable from process environment before MCP can inherit it; arbitrary-name subprocess regression added.
Signal cancellation suppresses only expected closed-reader errors, never final session flush/close or Harness Dispose/Drain errors; regression preserves durability failure.
Optional native file/shell composition is tracked by fstools/SOURCE.json, shell/SOURCE.json and nativetools/SOURCE.json; existing agent loop is unchanged.
Optional explicit provider request/output/retry/reasoning budgets for bounded smoke tests; defaults retained.
Explicit --use-env-proxy opt-in uses existing HTTP(S) proxy configuration; default direct transport and TLS verification unchanged.
Explicit --disable-thinking emits compatible Chat Completions thinking.type disabled; unspecified providers unchanged.
Optional trusted ACP working-directory admission callback reuses native workspace CheckCWD before new/load/resume effects; execution-time checks remain.

ACP resume/load interprets latest supported controller receipt and requires client MCP presence when recorded; malformed/unknown receipts fail explicitly. No configuration-equivalence or secret persistence is introduced.

Optional explicit read-only Skills catalog is tracked by skills/SOURCE.json; original Point SkillRegistry, provider scopes, implicit home/project roots, product bundles and invocation hooks remain excluded. Existing Harness tool registration/generation and fstools descriptor authority are reused.
Explicit operator context-window compaction wiring reuses the existing engine for new and resumed ACP sessions.
ACP projects provisional text/thought stream chunks with committed-output deduplication and callback lifetime fences; load replays committed history only.
Trusted native approval descriptors preserve registration ownership and validate generation before request_permission; only strict shell composition produces version 1 descriptors.
MCP terminal HTTP authorization failures stop reconnect and SDK fallback; public errors are sanitized while preserving classifications.

Explicit operator selectable-model declarations expose local adapter-owned catalog through existing ProviderRegistry and durable Agent.SelectModel; ACP select-option transport glue is new, not copied upstream ACP behavior. Default single-model behavior retained.

Idle-only ACP model change uses command lifecycle reservation without holding session lock across subscriber/persistence callbacks; close drains it and restoration revalidates explicit uniform context/output capacities.

Optional coding helpers mount explicit-root untrusted AGENTS.md context and session-backed todo_write only; plan-mode/user-question authorization remains excluded. Package-specific source pins preserved in agentinstructions/SOURCE.json and todos/SOURCE.json.

Optional complete native subagent registry/lifecycle restored; one-level in-process spawn/fork reuse existing AgentManager/Session ownership. Effective child caps are restricted, request budgets shared, ApprovalNever pinned, and parent MCP grants may be inherited. The duplicate extracted callback helper is removed; original provenance is retained under removed_files.
